questions.title: Block Denotation After if
questions.description: In Python, how is the body (block) of an if statement marked?

questions.title: Single Equals in Condition
questions.description: A beginner writes: if x = 5: (a single equals sign) instead of a comparison. What happens?
questions.Option1: x is assigned 5 and the block always runs
questions.Option2: SyntaxError — assignment is not allowed in a condition
questions.Option3: It is silently treated as a comparison with 5

questions.title: Falsy String Value
questions.description: Non-empty strings are truthy and the empty string is falsy. Which of these string values is falsy in an if condition?

questions.title: Alternative Branch Keyword
questions.description: Which keyword introduces the branch that runs when the if condition is False and no other case applies?

questions.title: Ladder Branch Selection
questions.description: In an if / elif / elif / else ladder, how many branches execute for a single input?
questions.Option1: All branches whose conditions are True
questions.Option2: Exactly the first branch whose condition is True (or the else)
questions.Option4: All branches, from top to bottom

questions.title: Missing Colon Outcome
questions.description: A student writes: if x > 5 (no colon) followed by an indented block. What is the result?
questions.Option1: The block runs only when x > 5
questions.Option3: The condition is ignored and the block always runs

questions.title: Purpose of pass
questions.description: What does the pass statement do inside an if block?
questions.Option3: Nothing — it is a placeholder where the syntax requires a statement

questions.title: Zero in Condition
questions.description: Numbers are truthy when non-zero. What does this two-line structure print: if 0: print("hi") followed by else: print("no")?

questions.title: Negated Empty List
questions.description: With x = [], does the body of the statement: if not x: execute?
questions.Option1: No — an empty list is truthy
questions.Option3: Error — not cannot be applied to lists
questions.Option4: Yes — an empty list is falsy, so not x is True

questions.title: Chained Comparison Truth
questions.description: Python allows chained comparisons like 1 <= 2 <= 3, which evaluates each link. What does this expression evaluate to?

questions.title: Ladder Path for Seven
questions.description: The ladder below is evaluated top to bottom for x = 7. Which line does it print?

questions.title: Nested If Two Outputs
questions.description: Both print statements sit inside the outer if (the second one after the inner if finishes). What exactly does the program output?
questions.Option3: big and mid, each on its own line

questions.title: Empty List Truthiness Branch
questions.description: An empty list is falsy in Python. Which branch of this program runs?

questions.title: Zero Checks Branch
questions.description: n is 0, which is falsy but still equals zero. Which branch of this ladder runs?

questions.codesnippet:
age = 20
status = "minor" if age < 18 else "adult"
print(status)
questions.title: Ternary Status Assignment
questions.description: A conditional expression picks one of two values at assignment time. What does this program print?

questions.title: Chained Pair Verdict
questions.description: Chained comparisons evaluate each link and combine with an implicit and. What does this program print?

questions.title: elif After Matching if
questions.description: The elif below belongs to the outer if, which already matched. What does the program print?

questions.title: Precedence of and over or
questions.description: and binds tighter than or inside Python conditions. What does this program print?
questions.Option1: no — the operators are applied strictly left to right
questions.Option2: yes — the and clause is grouped first, so the or still sees a True left side
questions.Option3: Error — or and and cannot be mixed

questions.title: String Zero Versus Integer
questions.description: x holds the one-character string "0", which is truthy and not equal to the number 0. What does the program print?
questions.Option1: one then four, on separate lines

questions.title: Nested Else Path
questions.description: x is 5. Trace the nested structure carefully: which line is printed?
